metadata.description: Claude Code plugins built because I needed them — plan-smith, harness, ux-ui, claude-x-codex

plugins.name: plan-smith
plugins.description: Forge plans through a two-stage pipeline: the main agent distills session intent into a context packet, a clean-context plan-writer drafts with a proven reasoning-frame library and Opus/Fable-derived writing styles, and the result is relayed verbatim. Includes a relay mode (disciplined draft + auditing revision) validated by a 26-plan experiment.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Meta-skill that analyzes a project's actual layering / separation-of-concerns and emits project-rules + review-gate.sh + UserPromptSubmit hook + harness-engineering skill from scratch.

plugins.name: ux-ui
plugins.description: Web + mobile: measure the real render (chrome-devtools for web; a mobile MCP or CLI snapshot harness for RN/Flutter/iOS/Android) → art-director critique of the measured snapshots → iterate to elegant → hard-block commits until APPROVED. (adds a PreToolUse commit-gate hook and 4 MCP servers)

plugins.name: claude-x-codex
plugins.description: Claude × Codex peer orchestration: the two plan, build, and review each other's work as peers, with evidence-based triage, a rebuttal round, and shared project context across both vendors. Unofficial community plugin. (adds a UserPromptSubmit hook; silent when mode is off)
